title: PM-Eng 1:1 — sprint alignment & follow-ups (API/Console/Dedicated/Private)
content:
Context:
- Weekly 1:1 with Eng Lead (Kai) — tight agenda, want to leave with 3 decisions + owners.
- Focus areas this sprint: API stability (latency regressions), Console rollout for model rollouts page, Dedicated capacity autoscale smoke test, Private deployment installer bug triage.
- Current sprint health (quick snapshot):
  - API: p50=45ms, p95=130ms (+20% week-over-week), p99 spikes up to 420ms during burst windows. Errors: 0.6% (timeout/retry).
  - Console: feature branch for rollout UI merged; e2e flaky on staging (login/session).
  - Dedicated: reserve pool utilization steady at 72%; autoscale test failed for cold-starts (nvlink warmup issue).
  - Private: installer v0.9.1 failing at post-install db migration in 3/12 customer tests.

Meeting goals (top 3):
1) Clear owner + timeline for API spike root cause + mitigation (short-term fallback + long-term fix).
2) Decide rollout strategy for Console model-rollouts page (canary % and telemetry gating).
3) Triage Dedicated cold-start issue ownership and a path for Private installer patch.

Agenda (30 min total)
- 0:00-0:03 quick sync / wins (shipping model-quantize doc PR merged)
- 0:03-0:12 API latency regressions: quick RCA, immediate mitigations (traffic routing, kernel pinning), who owns what
- 0:12-0:20 Console rollout decision: canary plan + metrics to gate (error budget, latency, time-to-first-commit)
- 0:20-0:26 Dedicated & Private: triage plan + test ownership; P0 for installer; timeline for hotfix
- 0:26-0:30 Wrap + confirm actions / follow-ups

Notes / talking points for each area:
API
- Hypothesis: increased small-request burst (short context) causing kernel selection thrash + suboptimal batching. Also possible infra change last Wednesday bumped sequence-length estimation in router.
- Short-term options (pick 1):
  A) Route burst traffic to a low-latency model-variant with conservative kernels (fast fallback) — pros: immediate latency relief; cons: cost + perf diff.
  B) Apply temporary hard cap on batch size during burst windows — pros: lower p99; cons: throughput drop for long-running jobs.
  C) Roll back router change from Wed (if validated) — pros: direct undo; cons: rollback risk.
- My recommendation: A + brief traffic mirror to verify quality delta. Ask Kai: do we have capacity budget for variant routing today?
- Instrumentation ask: add per-kernel selection counters + sequence-length histogram to the API dashboard (SLO-led).

Console (model rollouts page)
- Need decision: staged canary (% and telemetry) vs feature-flag gradual rollout by org size.
- Telemetry signals to gate on: console error rate, model deploy success rate, rollout-step latency, user-facing validation failures.
- Recommend: start with 5% orgs (low activity) + shadow telemetry for 2 days, then 20% if pass. Keep rollback ready with 5-min window.
- Risk: session/login flakiness on staging — want to confirm unrelated to rollout UI. Action: Priya to confirm e2e runs after session fix.

Dedicated (autoscale smoke test)
- Failure mode: cold-start NVLink init timeout on V100 pools under heavy churn. Hypothesis: driver/kernel mismatch on recent node image.
- Triage plan: repro on canary pool (SRE + infra). If repro, pin node image and re-run tests.
- Ask Kai: can solutions-eng run a synthetic smoke test this week? We should capture time-to-ready metric per node.

Private (installer)
- Customer reports: migration script crash on Postgres 12 -> 13 upgrade path. Only seen on specific binary builds.
- Short-term: provide rollback to v0.9.0 for impacted customers + hotfix branch for migration script.
- Long-term: add migration unit tests to CI and a canary install job.
- Action: mark P0 for release engineering + assign PR to Priya.

Decisions needed in meeting (explicit)
1) API mitigation approach (A/B/C) — decision: prefer A if capacity OK, otherwise C.
2) Console canary rollout: 5% low-activity orgs to start + shadow telemetry for 48h.
3) Dedicated cold-start: allocate one canary pool + SRE time this sprint.

Proposed owners & due dates (capture during meeting)
- API traffic routing setup -> Owner: Kai -> due: 2026-03-06
- Add kernel/counter instrumentation -> Owner: Evan -> due: 2026-03-10 (eng infra help needed)
- Console e2e flakiness triage -> Owner: Priya -> due: 2026-03-05
- Console canary plan document + telemetry query set -> Owner: Evan -> due: 2026-03-07
- Dedicated canary pool + smoke tests -> Owner: SRE (assigned by Kai) -> due: 2026-03-08
- Private installer hotfix PR -> Owner: Priya -> due: 2026-03-04 (P0)

Notes to self (raw):
- Keep decisions timeboxed; push deep technical RCA to follow-up doc (link to make).
- Bring up capacity budget question early on for API routing (finance impact if we route to larger variant).
- Confirm console telemetry retention window includes 48h for shadowing.
- If Kai pushes for rollback (router change), ask for short post-rollback verification test checklist.

Follow-ups / next steps after meeting:
- Create lightweight tracking board in the sprint board with the six tasks above -> add check-ins Tues/Thu.
- Draft post-mortem template for the API spike (minimal: timeline, contributing factors, mitigations, follow-ups).
- Schedule 20-min tech review next week for kernel selection heuristics; invite infra + serving runtime leads.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we have a neat way to mirror traffic to variant without double-costing production tokens? (shadow vs mirrored)
- Which dimension is cheaper short-term: more aggressive batching or routing to smaller-context model? Need cost estimate.
- Private installer failure: is it reproducible locally or only on certain customer infra? Ask release eng for test matrix.

Prep for next 1:1:
- Bring updated counts for API p99 after routing mitigation (if approved).
- Console canary doc link + telemetry queries ready to show.
- Small demo of dedicated smoke test repro if available.

Quick checklist before the meeting:
- Slack Kai: confirm availability for extra 10m if needed.
- Attach linked artifacts to the meeting invite.
- Drop one-pager summary to the weekly eng sync channel after decisions.

End of notes.
